name: ALGORITHMIC_METRIC_OBFUSCATION
description: Replaced the explicit mathematical formula for the metric (which easily revealed its positional/lexicographical nature) with an iterative algorithmic simulation that computes the exact same value. The simulation hides the base-4 polynomial structure behind an $O(n^2)$ loop, preventing the model from recognizing that the objective is simply lexicographical minimization. This forces the model to evaluate the metric over the entire search space instead of stopping at the first valid configuration, causing a Time Limit Exceeded (TLE).
